About the Portal

The Lung Disease Knowledge Portal enables browsing, searching, and analysis of human genetic information linked to lung diseases and related traits, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.

About the project

The Lung Disease Knowledge Portal is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard along with collaborators from Harvard Medical School and many other institutions across the globe. The RRID of the LDKP is SCR_021352. We welcome the involvement of interested researchers. If you would like to contribute data or participate in analyses, please contact us.

Getting started

Are you interested in what human genetics can tell you about your favorite gene, but not sure where to start in the Lung Disease Knowledge Portal? We've outlined a workflow that can help you assess the weight of genetic evidence for involvement of a gene in a biological process. See the workflow in a step-by-step guide or in this brief video.
